# v0.5.6 (2026-08-12)
Signed and notarized Release build of Foundation for macOS arm64.
Defaults to production (`https://foundation.trychroma.com`). Uses the saved default CLI profile.
Includes a bundled `foundation` CLI at `Foundation.app/Contents/Resources/foundation` (same version as this Mac release).
## Opening the app
Prefer `curl -fsSL https://install.foundation | bash`. Direct zip installs should open normally (Developer ID + notarized).
## Changes
* [BUG](mac): Stop advertising connect_and_install_slack until UI ships * [BLD](mac): Re-sign Sparkle nested helpers for notarization
